i1.title: Karl Lagerfeld Fleur d'Iris Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Soft, powdery iris wrapped in warm vanilla.

Karl Lagerfeld Fleur d'Iris Eau de Parfum 100ml is an amber floral fragrance for women from the Les Parfums Matières collection, launched in 2025. Mandarin and orange blossom open it bright and luminous, a heart of iris and orchid brings a soft, powdery elegance, and it settles into a warm, comforting base of heliotrope, vanilla and musk.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Mandarin, Orange Blossom
  • Heart: Iris, Orchid
  • Base: Heliotrope, Vanilla, Musk

Key details

  • Brand: Karl Lagerfeld
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Floral · Amber · Powdery
  • Wear: Women

Why you'll love it

  • A bright mandarin and orange blossom opening
  • A soft, powdery iris and orchid heart
  • A warm heliotrope, vanilla and musk base
  • Generous 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Fleur d'Iris smell like?

Mandarin and orange blossom first, then iris and orchid, finishing with heliotrope, vanilla and musk.

Is it for women?

Yes, it is a women's fragrance.
